newsitem.title: USA: Chiquita to take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Chiquita to take Q4 charge.

text.p: Chiquita Brands International Inc said it will report an estimated $40 million to $60 million unusual charge in its 1996 annual and fourth quarter results.

Chiquita said the unusual charge results from recent widespread flooding in Guatemala and Honduras causing damage to more than 4,000 banana producing acres, and changes in Chiquita's banana sourcing program as the direct and indirect consequence of these production interruptions.

The company said certain strategic undertakings designed to achieve further long-term reductions in the delivered product cost for Chiquita bananas through the modification of distribution also contributed to the expected charge.
Chiquita said that although the extent of the flood damage and cost of strategic actions is still being assessed, it is estimating the unusual charge to be in the $40 million to $60 million range.
Final results for the year are expected to be reported on or about February 18, 1997.
